## Why

The trailing-seven-day Gate p50 is 10.43 min against a
10 min target. Longest observed job: [python ci / python 3.14](https://github.com/stranske/Workflows/actions/runs/40032494229/job/120684428094)
(14.20 min), in `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml`.
Current share: 2.82%; distance: 0.043;
drainable_in: 7 days.

## Scope

Reduce the measured `python ci / python 3.14` bottleneck in stranske/Workflows's Gate without weakening checks.

## Non-Goals

Do not waive required checks or block merges on duration. Scaffold-only or partial
completion does not count: a plan without a measured reduction is unfinished.

## Tasks

- [x] Inspect `python ci / python 3.14` in `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml` and its called workflow using the linked run; identify the duration bottleneck.
- [x] Implement the bounded grammar-matrix optimization in `tests/scripts/test_pr_verifier_delivery_destinations.py` and retain `tests/scripts/test_pr_verifier_grammar_inventory.py` coverage; delivered by PR #4267 / merge `014ba9eeda65841ec377b6d353e59bf6ea22453b`.
- [x] Compare `python ci / python 3.14` Gate job durations using `gh run view <run> --repo stranske/Workflows --json jobs`, and attach run URLs and measurements below.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Live-verification gate: `gh run view 40551187519 --repo stranske/Workflows --json jobs,status,conclusion` returns success; `python ci / python 3.13` and `python ci / python 3.14` each have `completedAt - startedAt <= 600 seconds`. Retain the measured job URLs and output in the delivery evidence below.
- [ ] Live-verification gate: Health 85 reports trailing-seven-day Gate p50 at or below 10 min for seven consecutive daily measurements; retain the dated p50 series in `docs/reports/ci-budget.json` and this issue before closure. A single successful Gate does not satisfy this criterion.

## Implementation Notes

Health 85 updates measurements daily. The opener reserves `ceil(share * cap)`
slots for this repo before other materializations; the coordinator applies that
rule. Source report: `stranske/Workflows@ci-time-budget:docs/reports/ci-budget.json`.
First over-target measurement: 2026-10-27T11:44:41+00:00.
<!-- ci-time-budget:v1 -->


## Delivery evidence checked 2026-10-27

The timing implementation already exists in merged [PR #4267](https://github.com/stranske/Workflows/pull/4267), source #4258. Its retained before/after evidence measured Python 3.14 at 713 → 485 seconds and Python 3.13 at 668 → 507 seconds. Those are separate observed hosted runs; runner/cache variability is not isolated.

Fresh independent readback of successful [Gate 40551187519](https://github.com/stranske/Workflows/actions/runs/40551187519), head `dcb2d28859bb320a12047e44932db5a87135f7ea`, observed:

| Job | Started UTC | Completed UTC | Seconds |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| [Python 3.13](https://github.com/stranske/Workflows/actions/runs/40551187519/job/122355504848) | 2026-10-27T17:31:00Z | 2026-10-27T17:38:59Z | 479 |
| [Python 3.14](https://github.com/stranske/Workflows/actions/runs/40551187519/job/122355504921) | 2026-10-27T17:31:00Z | 2026-10-27T17:40:40Z | 580 |

Both current jobs are below 600 seconds. The original cited run40032494229 predates the delivered optimization; its 52,683-case JUnit artifact and 816.28-second test run were retained for provenance, not represented as current main.

The remaining owner is Health 85 / the existing CI-budget source owner: collect the seven dated daily measurements, assess the trailing-window criterion, and close only when that gate passes. No duplicate performance PR, workflow dispatch, protected workflow edit, or source acceptance waiver is implied. If a new current job breaches 600 seconds, reopen bounded diagnosis from that exact run rather than repeating the old optimization.

     `pytest tests/scripts/test_foo.py --cov=scripts/foo --cov-report=term-missing -m "not slow"`

     `pytest tests/ --cov=scripts/foo --cov-report=term-missing -m "not slow" -x`
2. Find the specific script in the coverage output table
3. Verify the `Cover` column shows the target percentage or higher
4. Only mark the task complete if the actual coverage meets the target
5. If coverage is below target, add more tests until it meets the target

IMPORTANT: Always use `-m "not slow"` to skip slow integration tests that may timeout.
IMPORTANT: Use targeted `--cov=scripts/specific_module` instead of `--cov=scripts` for faster feedback.

`gh workflow list --repo stranske/Workflows` identifies **Health 85 CI Time Budget**, workflow id `387854305`, path `.github/workflows/health-85-ci-time-budget.yml`, state `active`.

Published report inspected: `stranske/Workflows@ci-time-budget:docs/reports/ci-budget.json` blob `b917229e8f0cd9228754c6e30c4c0ef993dc0b99`. Health 85 stores trailing-seven-day Gate p50 in **minutes**. The 600-second gate is 10 minutes. These seven consecutive dates match `docs/reports/ci-budget.json` on PR #4491 (`748136bc`).

| --- | ---: | ---: | --- | --- |

2026-11-05 and 2026-11-06 runs concluded `failure`. Both logs say `ERROR: stranske/Workflows: measurement unavailable`. The 2026-11-06 published report error is a GitHub API 403 rate limit at 2026-11-06 11:58:23 UTC. The 2026-11-05 job log does not include the exception text.

No measured day in this window is at or below 600 seconds, and two dates have no p50. The sustained-performance gate stays incomplete. This comment does not change #4284's completion status.
